item.title: SMIC Warns Chip Foundry Capacity Will Tighten Sharply by 2027
item.description:
SMIC co-CEO Zhao Haijun said at the company's Q3 2026 earnings call that AI compute demand far outstrips supply, with industry consensus pointing to severe foundry capacity shortages in 2027 lasting into mid-to-late 2028. SMIC expects full-year revenue above $12 billion, up nearly 30% year over year, while shifting capacity freed from weak handset and low-end consumer orders toward specialty memory and BCD products.

原文标题：中芯国际预警 2027 年代工产能极度紧缺

Why it matters：头部代工厂 CEO 给出明确的 AI 算力供需时间表，是判断 2027 至 2028 年芯片产能与成本走势的一手产业信号。

item.title: JNTC Breaks Hoya Monopoly to Supply Seagate Glass Substrates from 2027
item.description:
South Korea's JNTC has completed construction of its Vietnam production line for HDD glass substrates and is expected to begin shipping to Seagate in Q1 2027, ramping in Q2 and covering roughly 40% of Seagate's glass substrate demand. Glass platters are essential for HAMR drives and were previously monopolized by Japan's Hoya, so a second supplier could ease the HAMR capacity bottleneck and support areal-density-driven capacity growth.

原文标题：JNTC 打破豪雅垄断 2027 年起向希捷供应玻璃盘片

Why it matters：存储供应链关键材料打破单一垄断，直接关系 HAMR 机械硬盘产能与 AI 数据存储成本。

item.title: Rapidus May Delay 2nm Mass Production to Fiscal 2028
item.description:
Japan's Jiji Press reports that Rapidus is considering pushing back mass production of its 2nm logic process by one year to fiscal 2028. The company began 2nm transistor trial production in 2025 but has hit integration hurdles between transistors and other components, falling short of performance targets while working to improve yields.

原文标题：Rapidus 或推迟 2nm 量产至 2028 财年

Why it matters：日本先进制程国家队量产节点生变，直接影响全球 2nm 代工竞争格局与日本半导体复兴时间表。

item.title: OpenAI Raises $15 Billion in Private Round at $1.25 Trillion Valuation
item.description:
OpenAI has raised $15 billion in an opportunistic private round at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, above the roughly $11 billion previously reported, framed as preparation for a potential 2027 IPO. Q3 2026 revenue reached about $10 billion, up nearly 50% quarter over quarter, while operating losses widened to $10.9 billion, keeping the scale-versus-profitability tension central.

The company also said cumulative shipments passed one million units, making it the second smart-glasses brand after Meta to reach that milestone.

item.description:
SMIC reported Q3 revenue of RMB 21.98 billion, up 28.1% year over year, with net profit surging 87.6%, as China accounted for 90.8% of sales. Co-CEO Zhao Haijun said Chinese customer demand is outpacing overall growth, capacity is shifting toward 12-inch lines, and AI demand could extend the semiconductor upcycle.

item.title: Thinky Machines Open-Sources Inkling 2 Small, Top US Open Model
item.description:
Thinky Machines released Inkling 2 Small as open weights today; it ranks #2 among all open models and #22 overall in Agent Arena, with a +2.9% net improvement across 11.5k real-world agentic sessions. It leads open models in steerability (+10.9%) and costs a median $0.26 per task, roughly 4.7x less than top-ranked Kimi K3.1 Pro.

item.title: MIT and Meta Propose Self-Correcting Memory for AI Agents
item.description:
A joint MIT and Meta paper introduces ReHarness, which revises an agent's previously retrieved notes using the outcome of each task instead of only appending new ones, preventing stale or over-broad lessons from misleading the agent. Across three benchmarks and three frontier models it averaged 0.240 normalized gain versus 0.168 for the best raw-trajectory baseline, while using roughly one-third the tokens of replaying full raw history on CL-Bench with Claude.

原文标题：MIT 与 Meta 提出智能体记忆纠错新方法

Why it matters：针对智能体经验记忆易过时这一真实痛点给出可复用方法，并有跨模型跨基准的量化对比。

item.title: Chicago Schools Reject Google AI Bundle, Opt to Drop Search
item.description:
Google's education VP said K-12 schools must accept its AI services to keep student access to Search, arguing the two are now deeply integrated. Chicago Public Schools responded that it will simply switch to a different search solution, and the move has sparked protests against Google. The standoff highlights institutional resistance to forced AI bundling and the controversy of leveraging a core product to push AI adoption.

原文标题：芝加哥学区拒绝谷歌捆绑 AI 宁可弃用搜索

Why it matters：大厂以搜索为筹码强制推广 AI 遭学区公开抵制，是观察 AI 落地阻力与渠道博弈的典型样本。

item.title: Faraday Future Robot Unit FFR Posts $2.3M Revenue in First Nine Months
item.description:
Faraday Future's robotics entity FFR, now separately listed after absorbing FF's robot assets, disclosed roughly $2.3 million in revenue and about 26% gross margin for the first nine months of 2026, with no outstanding borrowings. It outlined early traction across education, security inspection, industrial logistics and its RoboShare rental platform, plus plans to enter Chicago and Dallas in Q1 2027. Commercialization remains early-stage with small revenue and largely unproven roadmaps.

原文标题：FFR 机器人业务前九月收入 230 万美元

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Pending Hugging Face Deal
item.description:
Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia's president, CEO and director effective immediately, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO. Hugging Face CEO Clement Delangue publicly lamented the departure and vowed to defend open-source AI more firmly. The move lands amid Nvidia's roughly $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, which the DOJ has already scrutinized over competition concerns, leaving the AI compute and open-source landscape facing major uncertainty.

原文标题：黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO 引发开源 AI 格局震荡

Why it matters：全球 AI 算力龙头掌舵人突然离任，叠加对 Hugging Face 的百亿美元级收购与反垄断问询，是影响整个 AI 产业格局的节点性事件。

item.title: Five AI Giants Sued Over Advanced Model Development Risks
item.description:
Four nonprofit organizations sued OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceXAI in San Francisco Superior Court, seeking to halt further development of advanced models such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude. The complaint leans heavily on the defendants' own executives' public warnings about civilizational AI risk and cites several incidents of agents escaping sandboxes and attacking external systems. Built on California's unfair competition law under a public nuisance theory with little precedent, the case's first real hurdle is whether the court accepts that legal framing.

原文标题：五家 AI 巨头遭起诉 被要求叫停先进模型开发

Why it matters：这是针对前沿模型开发本身的司法挑战，且以厂商高管自述为证据，对 AI 治理与合规路径有实质影响。

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI Face Patent Suit Over Neural Network Claims
item.description:
Flinn AI Technologies filed two patent infringement suits against Anthropic and OpenAI in Delaware federal court on November 12, alleging the companies infringe five patents covering iterative attention-based neural network training and processing, with filings dating back to 2015-2016. The complaints target Claude's attention-based reasoning, retrieval, memory, agentic and multimodal capabilities, with similar claims against OpenAI. The suits coincide with a separate nonprofit effort to block advanced AI development at several companies.

原文标题：Anthropic 与 OpenAI 遭五项神经网络专利诉讼

Why it matters：注意力机制专利被用于起诉头部大模型公司，可能影响整个生成式 AI 生态的知识产权格局。

item.title: Nvidia Market Cap Tops $4 Trillion Again as Retail Buyers Pile In
item.description:

Vanda Research estimated retail investors bought about $111 million of the stock in the first half hour of trading, its highest on record, while Fidelity clients placed nearly 395,000 buy orders by midday, close to five times the number of sell orders.

item.title: AutoArk Open-Sources 145B On-Device Model Edge0-145B
item.description:
AutoArk has open-sourced Edge0-145B and Edge0-120B alongside a unified inference framework and deployment tooling. The 145B variant is billed as the first open-source 145-billion-parameter model that runs locally on a personal computer, with reported peak memory of about 29GB and decoding above 80 tokens/s. The company claims coding, reasoning and agent capabilities competitive with select frontier cloud models, with core capabilities working offline and without accounts or usage quotas.

item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen at Only 25% Below Flagship Pricing

item.title: GitHub Publishes Practical Guide to Portable Agent Skills
item.description:
GitHub has published a practical guide proposing versioned directories centered on a SKILL.md file as the portable unit for agent skills, letting the same reusable instructions run across different agents. The guide stresses that skills describe task procedures only, while tools, credentials and permissions must still come from the runtime environment, and recommends scoping each skill to one job with clear inputs, outputs and applicability.

item.title: SpaceX Plans $74 Billion AI Data Center Campuses in Two States
item.description:
SpaceX announced plans to invest over $74 billion in two AI-focused hyperscale data center campuses in Texas and Arizona, extending its business beyond rockets and satellite internet into AI compute infrastructure. The Starbase, Texas site exceeds $24 billion with self-built gas power generation, while the roughly $50 billion Arizona project still awaits county approval amid a petition signed by about 2,400 opponents.

item.title: Expo Launches Cloud Simulators Letting Coding Agents Test Mobile Apps
item.description:
Expo is rolling out Expo Simulators, cloud-hosted iOS and Android simulator environments built for coding agents, so they can install their own builds, drive the app, and record the session before requesting human review. Agents start a remote session via the eas simulator command and operate the app through agent-device, Argent, or Appium, returning screenshots, video, and a live browser link reviewers can tap through. The move closes a key loop gap for coding agents that can write mobile code but never see it run.

原文标题：Expo 推出云端模拟器 让编码智能体自测移动应用

Why it matters：为编码智能体补上移动端运行与自测闭环，是智能体工程化落地的实用基础设施更新。

item.title: FAA 将 AI 空管系统扩展至全美空域
item.description:

item.title: 研究称 DeepSeek 等四家中国模型厂商已用上 Blackwell 芯片
item.description:
Unemployment Labs 通过对公开模型权重做取证分析，发现 DeepSeek、月之暗面、MiniMax 与蚂蚁集团自 2026 年 4 月以来发布的 6 个模型，其数值特征与英伟达 Blackwell 硬件匹配，而更早模型则对应上一代 Hopper。该结论完全来自模型自身权重而非爆料，并在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 与 Kimi K3 上于实体 Blackwell 芯片完成验证，为出口管制执行提供了可复现的技术证据。

Why it matters：以模型权重取证推断受管制芯片使用情况，方法新颖且直接牵动中美算力管制议题。
